## Load libraries and data

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("table1")

cancer_data_augmented <- read_csv(file = "../data/03_cancer_data_augmented.csv", 
                        show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Overview tables

```{r}
cancer_data_augmented |>
  table1(x = formula(~ age + weight | estrogen_treatment),
         data = _)
```

```{r}
cancer_data_augmented |>
  table1(x = formula(~ vital_status + death_cause | estrogen_treatment),
         data = _)
```
